description: This file defines the interface for the IShell component in the WPEFramework PluginHost namespace. It includes class and struct declarations related to plugin shell management, remote connections, plugin states, and job handling. The file primarily consists of interface definitions, enums, and class declarations with virtual methods, and does not contain executable code.

classes.name: IShell
classes.description: Interface representing a plugin shell in the WPEFramework, providing methods for plugin control, web server management, subsystem access, notifications, and remote connection handling.

classes.name: IShell::ICOMLink
classes.description: Interface for managing inter-process communication links related to remote connections and notifications.

classes.name: IShell::ICOMLink::INotification
classes.description: Notification interface for ICOMLink events such as dangling and revoked connections.

classes.name: IShell::Job
classes.description: A class encapsulating scheduled jobs to activate or deactivate plugin states, implementing the Core::IDispatch interface.
